sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LEVEL HIGH PRESSURE WILL REMAIN CENTERED OVER THE FOUR CORNERS REGION WHILE AN UPPER LEVEL LOW PRESSURE SYSTEM OVER THE MN ARROWHEAD AT 12Z THU PIVOTS SEWD TO THE MI/OH BORDER BY 12Z FRI. A BELT OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL EXTEND FROM THE PAC NORTHWEST TO THE NRN ROCKIES AND FROM THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH THE OH VALLEY AND INTO NEW ENGLAND. A SURFACE LOW PRESSURE SYSTEM WILL MOVE NEWD FROM THE WRN OHIO VALLEY TO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES ACCOMPANIED BY A PRONOUNCED COLD FRONT.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES SWD TO OH/MS VALLEY
sections.text: TSTMS WILL LIKELY BE ON-GOING AT 12Z THU ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY SUPPORTED BY LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION AND A SHORT-WAVE DISTURBANCE IN ADVANCE OF THE UPPER LOW. RESIDUAL CLOUD COVER AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM MORNING CONVECTION LEADS TO SOME UNCERTAINTY ON THE EVOLUTION OF TSTMS LATER IN THE DAY...BUT ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT APPEARS LIKELY BY AFTERNOON OVER THE OH VALLEY IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT AND UPPER LOW. THIS AREA WILL LIE BENEATH STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW AND LIKELY DEVELOP MODERATE INSTABILITY BY AFTN WITH MLCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 1000 AND LOCALLY 2000 J/KG. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OF 40 TO 45 KTS WILL SUPPORT LINES/BOWING SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELL STORM STRUCTURES. FARTHER SW OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY...CLUSTERS OF MULTICELL STORMS IN ADVANCE OF THE FRONT WILL POSE A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND SVR HAIL IN A MOD-STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS.

sections.title: SRN AZ
sections.text: STRONGER ELY MID-LEVEL FLOW DEVELOPS BY AFTN AND TSTMS DEVELOPING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN MAY MOVE INTO A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH A RESULTING RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGESTS A PERTURBATION OVER NM WILL MOVE WWD POSSIBLY ENHANCING CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL. ..BUNTING/HURLBUT.. 08/09/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LONG WAVE TROUGH WILL REMAIN OVER THE ERN STATES AS A STRONG UPPER LOW ENTERING NERN MN DIGS SSEWD ACROSS THE UPPER GREAT LAKES TODAY BEFORE REACHING SRN LAKES MI LATE TONIGHT. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY INDICATES SEVERAL EMBEDDED SHORT WAVE TROUGHS...WITH THE PRIMARY ONE MOVING ESEWD ACROSS THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY ATTM. THIS IS EXPECTED TO MOVE ACROSS THE OH/TN VALLEYS TODAY AND GRADUALLY WEAKEN WITH TIME BEFORE APPROACHING THE APPALACHIANS TONIGHT. IN THE WEST...AN UPPER RIDGE WILL REMAIN CENTERED OVER THE FOUR-CORNERS REGION WHILE A SHORT WAVE TROUGH OFF THE NRN PACIFIC COAST MOVES INTO THE PACIFIC NW. AT THE SURFACE...A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM NRN ME SWWD ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND THE LOWER MO VALLEY. SEVERAL LOW CENTERS...EVIDENT ALONG THE FRONT OVER ERN KS AND ERN MO...ARE EXPECTED TO CONSOLIDATE INTO A DEEPENING LOW TONIGHT OVER THE LOWER OH VALLEY AND MOVE TOWARD NWRN OH BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. A COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE MN UPPER LOW WILL DEVELOP SWD AND EXTEND FROM NRN INDIANA SWWD ACROSS SRN IL..AR AND NRN TX BY THIS EVENING...REACHING A NWRN OH/WRN KY/SERN AR/CENTRAL TX LINE LATE TONIGHT.

sections.title: OH VALLEY INTO PA/NY
sections.text: NOCTURNAL CONVECTION IS CONTINUING FROM INDIANA INTO OH THIS MORNING WITHIN A WEAK LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION ZONE IN ADVANCE OF THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY SHORT WAVE TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD EWD/ENEWD TODAY. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS SUFFICIENT BREAKS IN CLOUDS FROM ERN OH INTO PA AND NY WHICH WILL ALLOW DIURNAL HEATING AND AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION TO OCCUR...WITH MLCAPE REACHING 1000-2000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. THIS SUGGESTS POTENTIAL FOR STORMS TO INTENSIFY ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE OH CONVECTION...WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING FARTHER EAST IN PARTS OF PA AND NY IN ASSOCIATION WITH TERRAIN FORCING AND A GRADUALLY DIMINISHING CIN. 25-35 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL AND SHORT LINEAR SEGMENTS WITH POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER STORMS TO PRODUCE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL INTO THE EVENING. SURFACE ANALYSIS AND RADAR INDICATES A COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EXTREME SRN IL ENEWD ALONG THE OH RIVER INTO SRN OH. THIS BOUNDARY MAY PERSIST INTO THE AFTERNOON WITH THE WRN PORTION POSSIBLY LIFTING NWD OVER SRN IL AND SRN INDIANA. THIS EFFECTIVE BOUNDARY MAY PROVIDE AN ADDITIONAL FOCUS FOR NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT AS THE LEADING EDGE OF DYNAMIC FORCING FOR LARGE

sections.title: MID SOUTH INTO NRN LA/NERN TX
sections.text: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP SWWD ALONG/AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. AREAS OF STRONG HEATING COUPLED WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE 70S WILL RESULT IN MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS MID/UPPER LEVEL DRY AIR SPREADING SEWD TOWARD THIS REGION...WHICH MAY LIMIT OVERALL STORM COVERAGE BUT ALSO ENHANCE MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND RESULTANT UPDRAFT INTENSITY. A FEW SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER CELLS.

sections.title: SRN AZ
sections.text: MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES STRONGER ELY MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL DEVELOP BY AFTERNOON OVER SRN AZ. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND MOVE INTO A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH A RESULTING RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGESTS A PERTURBATION OVER NM WILL MOVE WWD POSSIBLY ENHANCING CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL...ESPECIALLY ALONG THE MOISTURE DISCONTINUITY. HOWEVER...GRADUAL DRYING ALOFT IS EXPECTED TO LIMIT OVERALL CONVECTIVE COVERAGE.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: 12Z AREA SOUNDINGS SHOW RELATIVELY COOL MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND MODERATELY STEEP LAPSE RATES IN THE 900-600 MB LAYER. WITH AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE...THIS IS RESULTING IN 2000-3000 J/KG CAPE WHICH WILL SUPPORT STRONG UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT. VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER OVER SRN AL INTO PARTS OF GA AND SC WHERE STRONGER HEATING IS LIKELY TO OCCUR...WITH STORMS INCREASING BY LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON. SWLY FLOW IN THE MID LEVELS NEAR 20 KT WILL RESULT IN MARGINALLY SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR A FEW WEAKLY ORGANIZED STORMS TO DEVELOP WITH POTENTIAL FOR TO PRODUCE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..WEISS/SMITH.. 08/09/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE NEED FOR A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PERHAPS AIDED BY FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK IMPULSE NOW BEGINNING TO LIFT THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION...A SMALL STORM CLUSTER THAT INITIATED NEAR THE SOUTHERN SHORES OF LAKE ERIE HAS MAINTAINED STRENGTH ACROSS NORTHWESTERN PENNSYLVANIA...THROUGH THE MOUNT JEWETT PA AREA THE PAST FEW HOURS. SOUTHWESTERLY LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELDS ARE GENERALLY LIGHT...BUT A 30-40+ KT SOUTHWESTERLY 500 MB JET ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES IS CONTRIBUTING TO A MODESTLY SHEARED 20+ KT DEEP LAYER MEAN AMBIENT FLOW. THIS WEAKENS WITH EASTWARD EXTENT ACROSS SOUTHERN NEW YORK/NORTHERN PENNSYLVANIA...BUT A RELATIVELY MOIST AND GRADUALLY WARMING/DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER MAY COMPENSATE SOMEWHAT. INFLOW WITH CAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1500-2000 J/KG MAY CONTINUE TO SUPPORT VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS...ACCOMPANIED BY POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY HEAVY RAIN AND FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING. FURTHER UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH AND SURFACE COLD POOL EXPANSION MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION...POSSIBLY APPROACHING THE BINGHAMTON AND WILKES-BARRE/SCRANTON AREAS TOWARD 20-21Z. WHILE GUSTY WINDS MAY ACCOMPANY ACTIVITY...PERHAPS PRODUCING SPORADIC DAMAGE...MOSTLY TO TREES...THE ENVIRONMENT STILL DOES NOT APPEAR PARTICULARLY SUPPORTIVE OF A MORE SUBSTANTIVE BROADER SCALE DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING LINE OF TSTMS IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SOME INTENSIFICATION/ORGANIZATION OF THIS LINE IS POSSIBLE BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE LIMITED. A FEW SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE BUT ISOLATED COVERAGE IS ANTICIPATED TO LIMIT THE NEED FOR A WW. HOWEVER...THIS AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF BETTER STORM ORGANIZATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO PRIMARY LINES OF TSTMS CURRENTLY EXIST ACROSS THE AREA. ONE IS MOVING EWD ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF MIDDLE TN AND THE OTHER IS MOVING EWD/SEWD ACROSS ERN/NERN AL. ANOTHER TSTM CLUSTER IS BEGINNING TO DEVELOP ACROSS PORTIONS OF NWRN GA. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS MUCH OF THIS AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 70S AND TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S. 12Z SOUNDINGS AT BMX...FFC...AND TLH ALL DEPICT A MOIST AND DEEP WARM LAYER WITH FREEZING LEVELS ABOVE 13 KFT AND PWATS ABOVE 1.8 INCHES. CLOUD BREAKS AHEAD OF THESE LINES SHOULD ALLOW AT LEAST MODEST DESTABILIZATION AND LATEST RUC-BASED MESOANALYSIS INDICATES MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG IN ERN AL/WRN GA AND AROUND 1500 J/KG FARTHER N ACROSS ERN TN. RAP-BASED MESOANALYSIS APPEARS TO HAVE WARMED THE SURFACE TEMPERATURES MORE THAN CURRENTLY OBSERVED...LEADING TO HIGHER ANALYZED MLCAPE VALUES. SHEAR APPEARS TO BE THE LIMITING FACTOR REGARDING STORM INTENSITY. LATEST VAD PROFILES FROM BMX AND FFC DEPICT ABOUT 25 KTS OF 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR. AS SUCH...IT APPEARS MOST OF THE ACTIVITY WILL BE DRIVEN BY NEW DEVELOPMENT ALONG COLD POOLS/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WITH LITTLE STORM ORGANIZATION. BRIEFLY ENHANCED UPDRAFTS WILL RESULT IN THE POTENTIAL FOR PRECIPITATION LOADING AND A FEW WET MICROBURSTS BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS LOW. REGARDLESS...THIS AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF BETTER STORM ORGANIZATION. IN ADDITION TO BRIEFLY ENHANCED WINDS...WARM AND MOIST ATMOSPHERIC PROFILES WILL SUPPORT VERY HEAVY RAINFALL WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF FLASH FLOODING...ESPECIALLY ACROSS AREAS WITH POOR DRAINAGE/SATURATED SOILS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UNCERTAINTIES LINGER...BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THAT COULD REQUIRE A WATCH WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS UNDERWAY...BOTH ALONG A STALLED PORTION OF THE SURFACE FRONT EXTENDING EAST-WEST ACROSS THE SOUTHERN GREAT LAKES REGION...AND ALONG A SEGMENT OF THE FRONT BEGINNING TO ADVANCE SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. LOWER PRESSURE NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THESE SEGMENTS COULD PROVIDE THE FOCUS FOR AN INCREASE IN CONCENTRATION AND CONSOLIDATION OF STORMS...NEAR/WEST THROUGH NORTH OF THE CHAMPAIGN/URBANA AREA DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. FAIRLY STRONG MID-LEVEL COOLING AND LIFT IN THE EXIT REGION OF A 50-60+ KT NORTHWESTERLY 500 MB JET STREAK DIGGING SOUTHEAST OF THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF DEVELOPMENT. PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY CONCERNS DESTABILIZATION OF A BOUNDARY LAYER PREVIOUSLY IMPACTED BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW. BUT...WARMING TEMPERATURES WITH SURFACE HEATING...AND THE EASTWARD ADVECTION OF MORE STRONGLY HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER AIR ACROSS THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...IS UNDERWAY...AND CONTRIBUTING TO STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL ILLINOIS INTO INDIANA. AS AFOREMENTIONED PROCESSES COME INCREASINGLY IN PHASE LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...IT APPEARS CONDITIONS COULD BECOME MORE FAVORABLE FOR THE EVOLUTION OF AN ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM. THIS ACTIVITY MAY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND SOME HAIL...WHILE TENDING TO PROPAGATE ACROSS EAST CENTRAL ILLINOIS INTO CENTRAL INDIANA BY 23-00Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DEVELOPING ACROSS SERN OH AND FAR N-CNTRL KY DURING THE NEXT HOUR. THERE MAY BE ENOUGH STORM ORGANIZATION FOR SOME SEVERE WIND/HAIL...AND THIS AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASED LARGE SCALE LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH AN APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AS WELL AS ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL LIFT ALONG A CONFLUENCE BAND IS EXPECTED TO PROVIDE THE IMPETUS FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SERN OH. MOSTLY CLEAR CONDITIONS HAVE ALLOW TEMPERATURES TO RISE INTO THE MID TO UPPER 80S ACROSS MOST OF THE AREA...PROMOTING MODEST DESTABILIZATION. LATEST MESOANALYSIS DEPICTS MLCAPE AROUND 1000 J/KG TO 1500 J/KG ACROSS MOST OF THE AREA WITH LITTLE IF ANY MLCINH. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A BAND OF CU AND A FEW STORMS ALREADY DEVELOPING IN THE CONFLUENCE BAND LOCATED FROM SRN IND NEWD ACROSS CNTRL OH AND INTO EXTREME NWRN PA. LATEST MESOANALYSIS SHOWS EFFECTIVE SHEAR NEAR 20 TO 25 KTS...WHICH SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE AS AN APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH ENHANCES MID/UPPER LEVEL WIND FIELDS AND BULK SHEAR. AS A RESULT...ANY TSTMS THAT DO DEVELOP HAVE THE POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST MODEST ORGANIZATION AND UPDRAFTS STRONG ENOUGH TO PRODUCE SEVERE WIND/HAIL. ANY LINEAR ORGANIZATION ALONG A SINGULAR COLD POOL WOULD FAVOR AN INCREASED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. FARTHER S /FAR N-CNTRL KY/...ENHANCED UPDRAFT STRENGTH ALONG MESOSCALE BOUNDARY COLLISIONS MAY RESULT IN A BRIEF SEVERE THREAT. GIVEN THESE THREATS...THIS AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE EVENING AS STORMS GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS THE MCD AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASINGLY AGITATED CU FIELD IS BEGINNING TO BECOME MORE WELL-DEFINED ALONG A WEAK SURFACE TROUGH AND CONFLUENT SURFACE WINDS EXTENDING FROM SRN IL SWWD INTO W CNTRL AR AND ALONG THE OK/TX BORDER. MODIFYING THE UPSTREAM 18Z LAMONT SOUNDING FOR AMBIENT SURFACE CONDITIONS...MLCAPE NEAR 750-1000 J/KG AND MODEST NLY FLOW ALOFT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW SEMI-ORGANIZED MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS...GIVEN A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND EVAPORATIVE ENHANCEMENTS TO ANY DOWNBURSTS THAT OCCUR. ATTM...CONVECTIVE COVERAGE IS THE PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY REGARDING A WW ISSUANCE. ALTHOUGH DARKENING ON WV IMAGERY IN THIS REGION IS PERHAPS ALLUDING TO A WEAK VORT MAX...GENERALLY WEAK UPPER FORCING SHOULD LIMIT A MORE WIDESPREAD THREAT FROM DEVELOPING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE LIKELY...AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH WITH MIDLEVEL TEMPS NEAR -15 OR SO WILL CONTINUE TO DIVE SEWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY. AT THE SURFACE...A BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM NEAR THE TWIN CITIES SEWD INTO NRN IL...WITH A SUFFICIENTLY WARM AIR MASS TO THE W TO SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS. INCREASING SPEED SHEAR WITH HEIGHT IS RESULTING IN LONG STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS...WITH COOL AIR ALOFT FAVORING LARGE HAIL. WITH COLD DOWNDRAFTS...SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR AS WELL. ANY TORNADO THREAT SHOULD BE BRIEF AND WEAK DUE TO LACK OF ANY APPRECIABLE LOW LEVEL SHEAR AND SUBSTANTIAL OUTFLOW. STORMS WILL MOVE RAPIDLY SEWD AND MAY AFFECT THE QUAD CITIES AREA IN 2-3 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST ACROSS THE REGION...WITH SOME REDEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE. ANOTHER WATCH COULD BE NEEDED AS WW 568 NEARS EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STORMS CONTINUE TO THRIVE NEAR A WEAK LOW PRESSURE TROUGH...AND AHEAD OF A POTENT SHORTWAVE ALOFT. AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS STABILIZED NRN IND AND OH...WHERE ELEVATED SHOWERS WERE OCCURRING. BUT S OF THIS BOUNDARY...AMPLE MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY REMAINS. WLC PROFILER SHOWS INCREASING SPEEDS WITH HEIGHT WITH A STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPH FAVORABLE FOR SPLITTING CELLS. FURTHER COOLING ALOFT WILL BE POSSIBLE AND FORCING WILL REMAIN AS A COLD FRONT SURGES SEWD LATER THIS EVENING. THIS MAY COUNTERACT BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING FOR A CONTINUED THREAT OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. ..JEWELL.. 08/10/2012
